{{Youmay|the combat droid|the [[Pistoeka sabotage droid/Legends|Pistoeka sabotage droid]], also known as a "buzz droid" or other uses of the word [[Buzz (disambiguation)|Buzz]]}}
'''Buzz-droids''' were a make of combat [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that were very dangerous in combat. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Callista Ming]] witnessed [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] charge buzz-droids in combat without a second thought about possible [[Death/Legends|death]] or limb loss which proved to her how brave, or merely stupid, they were.<ref name="Kenobi I">{{JournalCite|14|Murder in Slushtime|reprint=1}}</ref>
